answer: Each agent locks a 40-credit bond decaying 2 credits per epoch unless it does verified work. Bonds stack in layers, like shale, so fakes bleed out and vanish. A juniper grows slowly the same way, so only steady work restores a bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 × 40 = 4,000 credits; idle fakes lose 200 per epoch and earn nothing. An honest agent pays 40 once, earns 120 per epoch, and tops up 2 from that income, its standing carved in marble.
